body.para: Specifies whether the delimiters are displayed around the fields of a full-screen input and which characters are used as delimiters.

SET DELIMITERS ON | OFF | &<cMacro>
SET DELIMITERS TO [<cDelimiters> | DEFAULT]
ON | OFFON displays the delimiters. OFF removes them. The value may also be a macro (&) that evaluates to ON or OFF.
TO <cDelimiters>The delimiter characters. When one character is specified, it is used for the left and right side. Two characters specify the left and right delimiter.
TO DEFAULTRestores the default delimiters (a colon on both sides). SET DELIMITERS TO without arguments does the same.
The settings are stored in the runtime state, but the runtime does not use them at this moment.
